meta.source: creativeupaay.com production CSS (Nov 2026) + logo files; social extensions marked in usage notes

tokens.name: brand-purple
tokens.usage: Upaay Purple. The primary brand colour (website --color-brand-purple). Ground of Ultraviolet slides, accent text on Paper. White text on it is 8:1.

tokens.name: brand-violet
tokens.usage: Website --color-brand-lavender. Secondary fill for one large shape per slide, never for body text grounds.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed purple from the website. Raised cards on Ultraviolet slides.

tokens.name: brand-lilac
tokens.usage: Logo lilac (the word CREATIVE). Accent text on Midnight (6.2:1). Never as text on Paper.

tokens.name: brand-indigo
tokens.usage: Logo indigo (the word UPAAY). The open-arc motif on Ultraviolet slides.

tokens.name: brand-midnight
tokens.usage: Deep navy from the website. Ground of Midnight slides and text on Marigold.

tokens.name: brand-lavender
tokens.usage: Website tint. Arc motif on Paper, soft text on Ultraviolet (6:1).

tokens.name: brand-marigold
tokens.usage: SOCIAL ADDITION (not on the website). Highlighter behind the 1-3 key words of a slide, and big stat numbers on Midnight. Always with brand-midnight text on it. Max one marigold moment per slide.

tokens.name: neutral-paper
tokens.usage: Website page background. Ground of Paper slides.

tokens.name: neutral-white
tokens.usage: Raised cards on Paper; text on Ultraviolet.

tokens.name: neutral-mist
tokens.usage: Website muted surface. Hairlines and image placeholders on Paper.

tokens.name: neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Website primary text. Headlines and body on Paper (15.6:1).

tokens.name: neutral-slate
tokens.usage: Website secondary text. Supporting copy on Paper (5.9:1).

tokens.name: neutral-muted
tokens.usage: Website muted text. 3.9:1 on Paper: use only at 24px+ (labels, counters), never for body copy.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Slide background. Set the theme on the slide with data-theme.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, before/after panels and quote boxes sitting on ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on ground and ground-raised in every theme (12:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Supporting sentences, captions, quote attribution on ground (5.9:1 or more in every theme).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent words inside a headline, chapter labels, stat numbers. 6:1 or more on ground in every theme.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Fill behind highlighted words (.cu-hl). Text on it is on-highlight.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text set on highlight (11:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, progress track, card borders.

tokens.name: motif
tokens.usage: The open-arc motif (echo of the logo's C). Decorative only, never behind text.

styles.name: type-hook
styles.sample: We almost missed a court deadline.

styles.name: type-headline
styles.sample: So we built a robot paralegal.
styles.usage: One headline per inner slide. Max 12 words.

styles.name: type-title
styles.usage: Card titles, CTA lines, before/after headings.

styles.name: type-stat
styles.usage: One number per Stat slide, set in accent.

styles.name: type-quote
styles.sample: It moved the needle for the people we built it for.

styles.name: type-body-lg
styles.sample: Every week, the team copied dates from emails into a spreadsheet by hand.
styles.usage: The main sentence under a headline. Max 35 words per slide.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: 24 rules now check every matter, every morning.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Uppercase chapter labels, series tags, slide counters, handle.

styles.name: type-reel-hook
styles.sample: Our client was 2 days from a lawsuit.
styles.usage: On-screen hook in the first 1.5 seconds and the reel cover.

styles.name: type-reel-caption
styles.sample: so we built it a brain
styles.usage: Burned-in captions, 2-5 words per card, lowercase allowed. Active word gets the highlight.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside pills and between tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (small), headline-to-body gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card inner padding, gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between slide sections (chrome, body, footer).

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Carousel slide margin on all four sides. Keeps cover text inside the 3:4 profile-grid crop.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Reel side margin for text blocks (left).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Photos, screenshots, highlighter marks (half value).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels. The friendly, rounded corner of the logo.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Series tags, CTA buttons, swipe pill.

tokens.name: carousel-width
tokens.usage: Carousel slide width. Export at 1080 x 1350 (4:5).

tokens.name: carousel-height
tokens.usage: Carousel slide height.

tokens.name: grid-crop-width
tokens.usage: The profile grid shows a 3:4 crop of a 4:5 post (centre 1012px). Keep cover text inside it.

tokens.name: reel-height
tokens.usage: Reel canvas height (1080 x 1920, 9:16).

tokens.name: reel-safe-top
tokens.usage: Keep text out of the top 250px of a reel (status bar, Reels label).

tokens.name: reel-safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Keep text out of the bottom 440px (caption, audio, handle).

tokens.name: reel-safe-right
tokens.usage: Keep text out of the right 150px (like, comment, share buttons).

tokens.name: reel-cover-crop
tokens.usage: The reel cover shows in the grid as the centre 1080 x 1440. Keep the cover hook inside it.
